title: Getting Here
text: The venue is located in Kochi, Kerala. The nearest airport is Cochin International Airport (COK), approximately 30 minutes from the venue. We recommend arranging transport in advance, and ride-sharing services are readily available.

title: Accommodation
text: We have reserved blocked rooms at nearby hotels for our guests. Please mention the wedding when booking to receive our special rate. A list of recommended hotels with booking links will be shared closer to the date.

title: Dress Code
text: We kindly request formal or traditional attire. The ceremony will be held indoors with air conditioning, so light layers are recommended. Feel free to wear your finest outfits — we'd love to see you looking your best!

title: Parking
text: Complimentary parking is available at the venue. Valet services will also be provided for your convenience. Please arrive 30 minutes before the scheduled start time to allow for smooth entry.

title: Children Welcome
text: We are delighted to welcome your little ones! A kids' corner with activities will be available during the reception to keep our youngest guests entertained.

title: Dietary Requirements
text: Our menu includes vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. If you have any specific dietary restrictions or allergies, please let us know when you RSVP so we can accommodate your needs.

title: Gifts & Wishes
text: Your presence is the greatest gift of all. However, if you wish to give a gift, a contribution to our honeymoon fund would be deeply appreciated. Details will be shared privately with close family and friends.

title: Weather & What to Bring
text: Kerala in March is warm and pleasant, with temperatures around 28-33°C (82-91°F). Light, breathable fabrics are recommended. An umbrella or light shawl may come in handy for indoor air conditioning.

title: Special Note
text: Please dress warmly for the evening reception.
